question: The Mughals were proud of their Timurid ancestry. How did they celebrate this?

options.text: By holding events like horse racing and shooting
By declaring a particular day as a holiday in the country
By each ruler getting a picture made of Timur and himself
By dedicating the day to soldiers

solution:
The correct answer is __**By each ruler getting a picture made of Timur and himself.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Mughals were proud of the timurid dynasty because their great ancestor had captured Delhi in 1398.
 
• Their pride was celebrated by getting a picture made
